name: Chokujou Keikou AlHara Game
original_name: 直情径行アルハラゲーム
source:
The heroine is part of a drinking circle in school.
A coming of age ceremony began for new members,
and her youthful kouhai sat next to her---

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE248705.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
女主角是学校酒圈的一员。
新会员的成人仪式开始了，
而坐在她身边的，是青春靓丽的后辈——

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE248705.html]DLsite English[/url]]
